    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="es">
    <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>Reuniones RVC</title>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
    <link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.json">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#CC2929">
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
    :root{
    --bg:#F5F3EE;--surface:#FFF;--surface2:#F0EDE6;--border:#E2DDD4;
    --text:#1A1714;--text2:#6B6560;--text3:#A09A93;
    --accent:#CC2929;--accent-l:#F9DADA;
    --red:#A93226;--red-l:#F5C6C2;
    --amber:#935E0A;--amber-l:#F5DFB8;
    --green:#1E4D32;--green-l:#C2DFD0;
    --blue:#1A3A6B;--blue-l:#D6E4F5;
    --r:10px;--touch:44px;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
    html{font-size:16px}
    body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);height:100vh;overflow:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
    /* ── LAYOUT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh}
    .hdr{background:var(--accent);padding:0 16px;height:54px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0;z-index:200}
    .hdr-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
    .hdr-rvc{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;letter-spacing:-1px}
    .hdr-title{color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
    .hdr-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:10px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;margin-top:1px}
    .hdr-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
    .hbtn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:none;color:#fff;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;height:30px;white-space:nowrap}
    .hbtn.primary{background:#fff;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
    .hbtn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
    .hbtn.primary:hover{background:#f0f0f0}
    .body{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden}
    /* ── SIDEBAR FILTROS (idéntico a tareas_rvc) ─────────────────────────── */
    .sidebar{width:220px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--border);overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
    /* stats */
    .sb-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:12px 12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .stat{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px}
    .stat-num{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1}
    .stat-lbl{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;margin-top:3px}
    /* filtros */
    .fblock{padding:6px 12px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .fblock-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:4px;padding:2px 0}
    .fblock-toggle{cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;user-select:none}
    .fblock-toggle:hover{color:var(--text)}
    .fblock-arrow{font-size:10px;transition:transform .2s;color:var(--text3)}
    .fblock-body.collapsed{display:none}
    .fopt{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);transition:all .12s;user-select:none}
    .fopt:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
    .fopt.active{background:var(--accent-l);color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
    .fcnt{font-size:10px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text3);font-weight:600;flex-shrink:0}
    .fopt.active .fcnt{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
    /* temas sidebar */
    .tema-dot-sb{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-right:4px}
    .fopt .tema-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
    .fopt .tema-inner span{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
    .clear-filters-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:8px;margin:8px 12px 4px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--red-l);color:var(--red);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;width:calc(100% - 24px)}
    .clear-filters-btn:hover{background:#EDADAA}
    .sb-add-tema:hover{color:var(--accent)}
    /* ── CONTENIDO PRINCIPAL ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .content{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
    /* ACTION BAR */
    .action-bar{padding:5px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;background:var(--surface);flex-shrink:0;transition:background .2s}
    .action-bar.sel{background:#8B1A1A}
    .ab-breadcrumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
    .ab-crumb{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;cursor:pointer}
    .ab-crumb:hover{color:var(--text)}
    .ab-crumb.active{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
    .ab-sep{color:var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
    .ab-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0}
    .ab-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;height:26px}
    .ab-btn-primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
    .ab-btn-primary:hover{background:#b01f1f}
    .ab-btn-sec{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff}
    .ab-btn-del{background:rgba(163,50,38,.5);color:#fff}
    .action-bar:not(.sel) .ab-btn{display:none}
    .action-bar:not(.sel) .ab-btn-always{display:flex;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text2);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .action-bar:not(.sel) .ab-btn-always:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
    /* SEARCH */
    .search-bar{padding:6px 18px 5px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--bg)}
    .search-wrap{position:relative}
    .search-icon{position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;pointer-events:none}
    .search{width:100%;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 12px 6px 30px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;outline:none;color:var(--text)}
    .search:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
    /* LISTA PRINCIPAL — cascada */
    .main-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 18px 60px}
    .main-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
    .main-list::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--surface2)}
    .main-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#A09A93;border-radius:4px}
    .main-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#6B6560}
    .sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
    .sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--surface2)}
    .sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#A09A93;border-radius:4px}
    .sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#6B6560}
    /* GRUPO TEMA */
    .grupo{margin-top:12px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden}
    .grp-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;background:var(--surface2);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .12s}
    .grp-hdr:hover{background:#E8E4DC}
    .grp-arrow{font-size:16px;color:var(--text2);transition:transform .2s;flex-shrink:0}
    .grp-arrow.closed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
    .grp-color{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
    .grp-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1}
    /* Drag & Drop */
    .drag-handle{cursor:grab;color:var(--text3);font-size:14px;padding:0 4px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;touch-action:none;user-select:none}
    .drag-handle:active{cursor:grabbing;color:var(--accent)}
    .grupo.dragging,.subgrupo.dragging{opacity:.4;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
    .grupo.drag-over-top{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)!important}
    .subgrupo.drag-over-top{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)!important}
    .grp-cnt{background:var(--border);color:var(--text2);font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600}
    .grp-opts{display:flex;gap:4px}
    .grp-opt-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);font-size:11px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
    .grp-opt-btn:hover{background:var(--accent-l);color:var(--accent)}
    /* SUBGRUPO REUNIÓN */
    .subgrupo{border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
    .sgrp-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px 8px 28px;background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:background .12s}
    .sgrp-hdr:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
    .sgrp-hdr.active{background:var(--accent-l)}
    .sgrp-arrow{font-size:15px;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .2s;flex-shrink:0}
    .sgrp-arrow.closed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
    .sgrp-num{font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);min-width:22px}
    .sgrp-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
    .sgrp-hdr.active .sgrp-title{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
    .sgrp-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;padding-left:12px}
    .sgrp-fecha{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text)}
    .badge{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap}
    .b-ok{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green)}
    .b-pen{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber)}
    .b-venc{background:var(--red-l);color:var(--red)}
    /* DETALLE (panel expandible dentro de la cascada) — mantenido para compatibilidad pero oculto */
    .det-panel{display:none}
    /* ── MODAL REUNIÓN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    @keyframes slideUp{from{transform:translateY(40px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
    .reu-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:transparent;z-index:400;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0}
    .reu-overlay.open{display:flex}
    .reu-modal{background:var(--surface);border-radius:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;height:100vh;max-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:none;animation:slideUp .22s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)}
    .reu-modal-hdr{padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface2)}
    .reu-modal-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;margin-top:2px}
    .reu-modal-x{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;color:var(--text3);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1}
    .reu-modal-x:hover{background:var(--border)}
    .reu-modal-body{flex:1;overflow-y:scroll;padding:16px 18px 24px;min-height:0}
    .reu-modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
    .reu-modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--surface2);border-radius:0}
    .reu-modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#A09A93;border-radius:4px}
    .reu-modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#6B6560}
    .reu-modal-footer{padding:10px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface);position:relative;z-index:10}
    /* Secciones del detalle */
    .dsec{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
    .dsec-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 14px;background:var(--surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .dsec-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
    .dsec-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%}
    .dsec-action{font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;background:none;border:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:5px}
    .dsec-action:hover{background:var(--accent-l)}
    .dsec-body{padding:12px 14px}
    /* inputs */
    .fi{width:100%;background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);outline:none;resize:vertical;transition:border-color .12s}
    .fi:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
    .fi.ta{min-height:72px;resize:vertical}
    .fi-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
    .fi-group{margin-bottom:10px}
    .fi-group:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
    .fi-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
    .fi-row-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
    /* participantes */
    .part-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 10px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:5px}
    .part-info{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
    .part-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
    .part-cargo{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;flex-shrink:1}
    .del-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;padding:3px 5px;border-radius:4px}
    .del-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-l)}
    /* ── JERARQUÍA DE TEMAS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .th-sec{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
    .th-sec-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;background:var(--surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
    .th-sec-hdr:hover{background:#E8E4DC}
    .th-sec-arrow{font-size:15px;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .2s;flex-shrink:0}
    .th-sec-arrow.closed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
    .th-sec-lbl{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;flex:1;border-bottom:1px dashed transparent;}
    .edit-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex:1;min-width:0}
    .edit-pencil{font-size:12px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;transform:rotate(-45deg);display:inline-block;line-height:1}
    .edit-wrap:hover .edit-pencil{opacity:.5}
    .edit-wrap:focus-within .edit-pencil{opacity:.8}
    .th-sec-lbl:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--text3);}
    .th-sec-lbl:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);outline:none;}
    .th-sec-body{padding:3px 4px}
    /* Nivel 1 — Grupo */
    .th-grupo{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:3px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg)}
    .th-grupo-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px;background:#EDEAE4;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
    .th-grupo-hdr:hover{background:#E2DED7}
    .th-g-arrow{font-size:14px;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .2s;flex-shrink:0}
    .th-g-arrow.closed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
    .th-g-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1;background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px dashed transparent;outline:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:text;border-radius:0}
    .th-g-name:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--text3);}
    .th-g-name:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);}
    .th-grupo-body{padding:3px 5px;background:#fff}
    /* Nivel 2 — Subgrupo */
    .th-sub{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;margin-bottom:3px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
    .th-sub-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--surface2);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
    .th-sub-hdr:hover{background:var(--border)}
    .th-s-arrow{font-size:13px;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .2s;flex-shrink:0}
    .th-s-arrow.closed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
    .th-s-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);flex:1;background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px dashed transparent;outline:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:text;border-radius:0}
    .th-s-name:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--text3);}
    .th-s-name:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);}
    .th-sub-body{padding:3px 5px;background:#fff}
    /* Nivel 3 — Subgrupo 2 */
    .th-sub2{border:1px solid var(--blue-l);border-radius:5px;margin-bottom:3px;margin-top:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
    .th-sub2-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--blue-l);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
    .th-sub2-hdr:hover{background:#C5D8F0}
    .th-s2-arrow{font-size:13px;color:var(--blue);transition:transform .2s;flex-shrink:0}
    .th-s2-arrow.closed{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
    .th-s2-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--blue);flex:1;background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px dashed transparent;outline:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:text;border-radius:0}
    .th-s2-name:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--blue);opacity:.7;}
    .th-s2-name:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue);}
    .th-sub2-body{padding:5px 8px;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
    /* Acuerdos */
    .ac-block{background:#EAF2ED;border:1px solid #D0E8D8;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 8px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px}
    .ac-dot{color:var(--green);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px}
    .ac-txt{flex:1;background:none;border:none;outline:none;font-size:12px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);resize:none;min-height:20px}
    .ac-txt:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 4px}
    /* Drag handles en temas */
    .th-drag{cursor:grab;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;padding:0 3px;flex-shrink:0}
    .th-drag:active{cursor:grabbing}
    /* Add buttons de nivel */
    .th-add-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;border:1px dashed var(--border);background:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;margin-top:4px;transition:all .12s}
    .th-add-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-l)}
    .th-del-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);font-size:11px;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0}
    .th-del-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-l)}
    /* tareas */
    .task-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:5px 8px;background:#EAF2ED;border:1px solid #D0E8D8;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:3px;transition:background .1s}
    .task-row:hover{background:#f7f4ef}
    .task-chk{width:16px;height:16px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .12s;font-size:10px}
    .task-chk.en_progreso{background:var(--amber);border-color:var(--amber);color:#fff}
    .task-chk.completada{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
    .task-row.is-done .task-title{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--text3)}
    .estado-pill{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}
    .ep-ingresada{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text2)}
    .ep-en_progreso{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber)}
    .ep-completada{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green)}
    .task-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
    .task-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}
    .task-row.is-done .task-title{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--text3)}
    .task-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .task-resp{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2)}
    .task-plazo{font-size:11px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;color:var(--text3)}
    .task-plazo.v{color:var(--red);font-weight:600}
    .task-plazo.h{color:var(--amber);font-weight:600}
    /* nueva tarea mini */
    .ntask-form{background:var(--surface);border:1.5px dashed var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:10px;margin-top:6px;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
    .ntask-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
    /* add row */
    .add-row{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:6px}
    .add-inp{flex:1;background:var(--bg);border:1.5px dashed var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);outline:none}
    .add-inp:focus{border-color:var(--accent);border-style:solid}
    .add-btn{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}
    .add-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-l)}
    .add-btn.p{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:none}
    .add-btn.p:hover{background:#b01f1f}
    /* add group (nuevo tema o nueva reunión) */
    .add-grupo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);transition:all .15s;margin-top:6px}
    .add-grupo:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-l)}
    /* det header acciones */
    .det-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px}
    .det-btns{display:flex;gap:7px}
    .dbt{padding:6px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:all .12s}
    .dbt-acta{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
    .dbt-acta:hover{background:#b01f1f}
    .dbt-sec{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text2);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .dbt-sec:hover{background:var(--border)}
    /* empty */
    .empty{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:60px 20px;text-align:center;gap:10px}
    .empty-ico{font-size:36px;opacity:.3}
    .empty-ttl{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2)}
    .empty-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.5;max-width:240px}
    /* ── MODAL ACTA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .modal-ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:500;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
    .modal{background:var(--surface);border-radius:14px;width:100%;max-width:700px;max-height:88vh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
    .modal-hdr{padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0}
    .modal-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
    .modal-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px}
    .modal-x{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;color:var(--text3);padding:4px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1}
    .modal-x:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
    .modal-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px 18px}
    .modal-footer{padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-shrink:0}
    .acta-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:12px}
    .atab{padding:6px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text2);transition:all .12s}
    .atab.active{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
    .acta-pre{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:16px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text);white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;min-height:280px;outline:none}
    .mail-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
    .mail-row{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px}
    .mail-lbl{color:var(--text3);font-weight:600;min-width:52px;flex-shrink:0}
    .mail-val{color:var(--text)}
    .mail-val.subj{font-weight:600}
    .mail-cuerpo{padding:14px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text);white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;outline:none;min-height:220px}
    /* toast */
    .toast{position:fixed;bottom:22px;right:22px;background:var(--text);color:#fff;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;z-index:999;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:all .2s;pointer-events:none}
    .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
    ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:2px}
    /* ── APUNTES EDITOR ─────────────────────────── */
    .apuntes-wrap{margin-top:4px;margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
    .apuntes-toolbar{display:none;gap:2px;padding:4px 6px;background:var(--surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:center}
    .apuntes-toolbar.visible{display:flex}
    .apuntes-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;line-height:1.2}
    .apuntes-btn:hover{background:var(--border);color:var(--text)}
    .apuntes-btn.active{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
    .apuntes-color{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
    .apuntes-color:hover,.apuntes-color.sel{border-color:var(--text)}
    .apuntes-editor{min-height:32px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);outline:none;line-height:1.6;overflow:hidden}
    .apuntes-editor[data-placeholder]:empty::before{content:attr(data-placeholder);color:var(--text3);pointer-events:none}
    .apuntes-editor ul,.apuntes-editor ol{padding-left:20px;margin:4px 0}
    .apuntes-editor li{margin:2px 0}
    .apuntes-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#8B6E3A;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;margin-bottom:3px;margin-top:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
    </style>
    <!-- PANTALLA LOGIN -->
    <style>
    #login-screen{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:#1A1A2E;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;z-index:9999}
    .login-box{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:40px 48px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);max-width:380px;width:90%}
    .login-logo{background:#C8102E;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px}
    .login-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#1A1A2E;margin-bottom:6px}
    .login-sub{font-size:13px;color:#888;margin-bottom:28px}
    .login-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;background:#1A1A2E;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 24px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;width:100%;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:background .15s}
    .login-btn:hover{background:#C8102E}
    .login-btn svg{flex-shrink:0}
    #user-info{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);max-width:140px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;cursor:default}
    .logout-btn{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
    .logout-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
    </style>

    <div style="position:relative">
    <button class="hbtn" onclick="toggleMenuApp()" id="btn-menu-app" title="Menú">☰</button>
    <div id="menu-app" style="display:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:36px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.15);min-width:180px;z-index:999;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border)">
    <div style="padding:6px 0">
    <button onclick="exportar();toggleMenuApp()" style="width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--surface2)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='none'">↓ Exportar JSON</button>
    <button onclick="exportarTareasExcel();toggleMenuApp()" style="width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--surface2)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='none'">📊 Exportar tareas a Excel</button>
    <button onclick="importarJSON();toggleMenuApp()" style="width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--surface2)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='none'">↑ Importar JSON</button>
    <div style="height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:4px 0"></div>
    <button onclick="mostrarModalPerfil();toggleMenuApp()" style="width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--surface2)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='none'">👤 Editar mi perfil</button>
    <div style="height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:4px 0"></div>
    <button onclick="cerrarSesion();toggleMenuApp()" style="width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--surface2)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='none'">⎋ Cerrar sesión</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <button class="hbtn primary" onclick="agregarTema()">+ Nuevo tema</button>

    <button class="logout-btn" onclick="cerrarSesion()">Salir</button>

    <div class="fopt" onclick="setFiltro('estadoTarea','ingresada',this)"><span>⬜ Ingresada</span><span class="fcnt" id="fc-est-ing">0</span></div>

    <script type="module">
    // ── COLORES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const COLS = ['#CC2929','#1E4D32','#935E0A','#1A3A6B','#5B2D8E','#0D6B6B','#8B4513','#1A5C6B'];
    // ── ESTADO ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    let S = {
    temas: [
    { id:1, nombre:'Créditos Directos', color:'#CC2929',
    reuniones:[
    { id:101, titulo:'Reunión 1', fecha:'2026-06-03', tipo:'seguimiento',
    participantes:[{n:'Rodrigo Ortiz',c:'Gerente General'},{n:'Fernando Arancibia',c:'Gerente Adm. y Finanzas'},{n:'Francisco Ibarra',c:'Subgerente Control de Gestión'}],
    objetivo:'Revisar cartera de créditos directos y definir criterios de aprobación Q3.',
    reunionAnteriorId: null,
    temasAnt: [
    { id:'ta1', nombre:'Cartera actual', subgrupos:[

    { id:'s1', nombre:'Morosidad', acuerdos:['Morosidad 2.3%, dentro del rango aceptable'], tareas:[{id:1001,t:'Informe morosidad Q2',r:'Francisco Ibarra',p:'2026-06-10',done:true}] }
    ]}
    ]},
    { id:'ta2', nombre:'Criterios Q3', subgrupos:[
    { id:'sg2', nombre:'Score aprobación', sub2:[
    { id:'s2', nombre:'Parámetros', acuerdos:['Score mínimo 650. Excepciones con GG.'], tareas:[{id:1002,t:'Propuesta criterios score Q3',r:'Fernando Arancibia',p:'2026-06-17',done:false}] }
    ]}
    ]}
    ],
    temasNuevos: [
    { id:'tn1', nombre:'Provisión adicional', subgrupos:[
    { id:'sgn1', nombre:'Propuesta', sub2:[
    { id:'sn1', nombre:'Directorio', acuerdos:['Se revisará propuesta con Directorio.'], tareas:[] }
    ]}
    ]}
    ],
    comentGeneral:'',
    tareas:[]
    },
    { id:102, titulo:'Reunión 2', fecha:'2026-06-17', tipo:'seguimiento',
    participantes:[{n:'Rodrigo Ortiz',c:'Gerente General'},{n:'Francisco Ibarra',c:'Subgerente Control de Gestión'}],
    objetivo:'Seguimiento Reunión 1 y revisión propuesta de provisión.',
    reunionAnteriorId: 101,
    temasAnt: [],
    temasNuevos: [],
    comentGeneral:'',
    tareas:[{id:1003,t:'Enviar propuesta provisión al Directorio',r:'Rodrigo Ortiz',p:'2026-06-20',done:false}]
    }
    ]
    },
    { id:2, nombre:'Gestión Documental IA', color:'#1E4D32',
    reuniones:[
    { id:201, titulo:'Reunión 1', fecha:'2026-06-05', tipo:'decision',
    participantes:[{n:'Rodrigo Ortiz',c:'Gerente General'},{n:'Fernando Arancibia',c:'Gerente Adm. y Finanzas'},{n:'Francisco Ibarra',c:'Subgerente Control de Gestión'}],
    objetivo:'Presentar propuesta IA para gestión documental y definir piloto.',
    reunionAnteriorId: null,
    temasAnt: [],
    temasNuevos: [
    { id:'tn201', nombre:'Gestión IA', subgrupos:[
    { id:'sg201', nombre:'Herramientas', sub2:[
    { id:'s201', nombre:'Evaluación', acuerdos:['Se evaluarán ambas herramientas en paralelo.'], tareas:[{id:2001,t:'Preparar ambiente NotebookLM y Copilot',r:'Francisco Ibarra',p:'2026-06-09',done:false},{id:2002,t:'Contactar encargado Google para licencias',r:'Francisco Ibarra',p:'2026-06-12',done:false}] }
    ]}
    ]}
    ],
    comentGeneral:'',
    tareas:[]
    }
    ]
    },
    { id:3, nombre:'Gestión de Reuniones', color:'#1A3A6B',
    reuniones:[
    { id:301, titulo:'Reunión 1', fecha:'2026-06-11', tipo:'planificacion',
    participantes:[{n:'Rodrigo Ortiz',c:'Gerente General'},{n:'Francisco Ibarra',c:'Subgerente Control de Gestión'}],
    objetivo:'Presentar herramienta HTML para gestión de reuniones y validar piloto.',
    reunionAnteriorId: null,
    temasAnt: [],
    temasNuevos: [
    { id:'tn301', nombre:'Herramienta HTML', subgrupos:[
    { id:'sg301', nombre:'Demo y validación', sub2:[
    { id:'s301', nombre:'Piloto', acuerdos:['App standalone HTML, sin dependencia M365.','GG aprueba piloto esta semana.'], tareas:[{id:3001,t:'Distribuir herramienta a 20 coordinadores',r:'Francisco Ibarra',p:'2026-06-14',done:false}] }
    ]}
    ]}
    ],
    comentGeneral:'',
    tareas:[]
    }
    ]
    }
    ],
    abiertos: { temas:{}, reuniones:{} }, // ids expandidos
    reunionActiva: null, // id reunión seleccionada
    modoLectura: false, // true si la reunión abierta no es la más reciente
    filtros: { tema:'', estadoTarea:'', tipo:'', responsable:'', soloUltima:false },
    tabActiva: 'acta',
    };
    // ── SIDEBAR ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderSidebar() {
    const hoy = today();
    let allTareas = [];
    S.temas.forEach(t => {
    if (!t.reuniones.length) return;
    const ultimaReu = t.reuniones[0];
    const esPendiente = ta => (ta.estado||'ingresada') !== 'completada';
    const collectT = (lista) => {
    (lista||[]).forEach(g => {
    (g.tareas||[]).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    (g.subgrupos||[]).forEach(sg => {
    (sg.tareas||[]).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    (sg.sub2||[]).forEach(s2 => {
    (s2.tareas||[]).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    });
    });
    });
    };
    // Nuevos temas: todas las tareas
    collectT(ultimaReu.temasNuevos);
    // Temas anteriores: solo tareas pendientes (compromisos vigentes)
    const collectPendientes = (lista) => {
    (lista||[]).forEach(g => {
    (g.tareas||[]).filter(esPendiente).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    (g.subgrupos||[]).forEach(sg => {
    (sg.tareas||[]).filter(esPendiente).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    (sg.sub2||[]).forEach(s2 => {
    (s2.tareas||[]).filter(esPendiente).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    });
    });
    });
    };
    collectPendientes(ultimaReu.temasAnt);
    // Tareas globales de la reunión
    (ultimaReu.tareas||[]).forEach(ta => allTareas.push({...ta, tema: t.nombre}));
    });
    const getEst = t => t.estado || (t.done ? 'completada' : 'ingresada');
    const pen = allTareas.filter(t=>getEst(t)!=='completada').length;
    const venc = allTareas.filter(t=>getEst(t)!=='completada' && t.p < hoy).length;
    const comp = allTareas.filter(t=>getEst(t)==='completada').length;
    const ing = allTareas.filter(t=>getEst(t)==='ingresada').length;
    const prog = allTareas.filter(t=>getEst(t)==='en_progreso').length;
    const act = allTareas.filter(t=>getEst(t)==='ingresada'||getEst(t)==='en_progreso').length;
    const total = allTareas.length;
    // Stats
    document.getElementById('sb-stats').innerHTML = `
    <div class="stat" style="background:var(--surface2)"><div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--text)">${pen}</div><div class="stat-lbl" style="color:var(--text3)">Pendientes</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="background:var(--red-l)"><div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--red)">${venc}</div><div class="stat-lbl" style="color:var(--red)">Vencidas</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="background:var(--green-l)"><div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--green)">${comp}</div><div class="stat-lbl" style="color:var(--green)">Completadas</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="background:var(--amber-l)"><div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--amber)">${total}</div><div class="stat-lbl" style="color:var(--amber)">Total tareas</div></div>
    `;
    // Filtro temas
    document.getElementById('fb-temas').innerHTML =
    `<div class="fopt ${!S.filtros.tema?'active':''}" onclick="setFiltro('tema','',this)"><span>Todos</span><span class="fcnt">${S.temas.reduce((a,t)=>a+t.reuniones.length,0)}</span></div>` +
    S.temas.map(t => {
    const activo = S.filtros.tema === String(t.id);
    return `<div class="fopt ${activo?'active':''}" onclick="setFiltro('tema','${t.id}',this)">
    <div class="tema-inner"><div class="tema-dot-sb" style="background:${t.color}"></div><span>${esc(t.nombre)}</span></div>
    <span class="fcnt">${t.reuniones.length}</span>
    </div>`;
    }).join('');
    // Filtro responsables
    const resps = [...new Set(allTareas.map(t=>t.r))].filter(Boolean);
    document.getElementById('fb-responsables').innerHTML =
    `<div class="fopt ${!S.filtros.responsable?'active':''}" onclick="setFiltro('responsable','',this)"><span>Todos</span></div>` +
    resps.map(r => {
    const cnt = allTareas.filter(t=>t.r===r).length;
    return `<div class="fopt ${S.filtros.responsable===r?'active':''}" onclick="setFiltro('responsable','${esc(r)}',this)">
    <span>${esc(r.split(' ')[0])}</span><span class="fcnt">${cnt}</span>
    </div>`;
    }).join('');
    // Contadores estado
    document.getElementById('fc-est-all').textContent = allTareas.length;
    document.getElementById('fc-est-act').textContent = act;
    document.getElementById('fc-est-ing').textContent = ing;
    document.getElementById('fc-est-prog').textContent = prog;
    document.getElementById('fc-est-pen') && (document.getElementById('fc-est-pen').textContent = pen);
    document.getElementById('fc-est-venc').textContent = venc;
    document.getElementById('fc-est-comp').textContent = comp;
    // Sincronizar estado visual del botón "solo última reunión"
    const btnUltima = document.getElementById('fopt-ultima');
    if (btnUltima) btnUltima.classList.toggle('active', S.filtros.soloUltima);
    }
    function toggleFblock(el) {
    const body = el.parentElement.querySelector('.fblock-body');
    const arrow = el.querySelector('.fblock-arrow');
    body.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    arrow.style.transform = body.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'rotate(-90deg)' : '';
    }
    function clearAllFilters() {
    S.filtros = { tema:'', estadoTarea:'', tipo:'', responsable:'', soloUltima:false };
    // Reset búsqueda
    const search = document.getElementById('search');
    if (search) search.value = '';
    // Reset active en fopt (poner Todos activo en cada bloque)
    document.querySelectorAll('.fblock-body').forEach(body => {
    body.querySelectorAll('.fopt').forEach(o => o.classList.remove('active'));
    const first = body.querySelector('.fopt');
    if (first) first.classList.add('active');
    });
    const btnUltima = document.getElementById('fopt-ultima');
    if (btnUltima) btnUltima.classList.remove('active');
    renderAll();
    toast('Filtros limpiados');
    }
    function toggleSoloUltima(el) {
    S.filtros.soloUltima = !S.filtros.soloUltima;
    el.classList.toggle('active', S.filtros.soloUltima);
    renderMain();
    }
    function setFiltro(key, val, el) {
    S.filtros[key] = val;
    el.closest('.fblock-body').querySelectorAll('.fopt').forEach(o => o.classList.remove('active'));
    el.classList.add('active');
    renderSidebar();
    renderMain();
    }
    // ── RENDER PRINCIPAL (cascada) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderMain() {
    const lista = document.getElementById('main-list');
    const q = document.getElementById('search').value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const hoy = today();
    // filtrar temas
    let temasFilt = S.temas;
    if (S.filtros.tema) temasFilt = temasFilt.filter(t => String(t.id) === S.filtros.tema);
    // construir HTML
    let html = '';
    let totalReus = 0;
    temasFilt.forEach(tema => {
    // filtrar reuniones dentro del tema
    let reus = tema.reuniones.filter(r => {
    if (S.filtros.tipo && r.tipo !== S.filtros.tipo) return false;
    // Filtro de búsqueda de texto
    if (q && !matchSearch(r, tema, q)) return false;
    // Filtro de estado/responsable: solo aplica sobre la última reunión del tema
    if (S.filtros.estadoTarea || S.filtros.responsable) {
    const ultimaId = tema.reuniones[0]?.id;
    if (r.id !== ultimaId) return false; // excluir reuniones no-últimas cuando hay filtro activo
    const tareasReu = [];
    const esPendiente = t => (t.estado||'ingresada') !== 'completada';
    const collectT = (lista, soloP) => (lista||[]).forEach(g => {
    (g.tareas||[]).forEach(t => { if(!soloP||esPendiente(t)) tareasReu.push(t); });
    (g.subgrupos||[]).forEach(sg => {
    (sg.tareas||[]).forEach(t => { if(!soloP||esPendiente(t)) tareasReu.push(t); });
    (sg.sub2||[]).forEach(s2 => (s2.tareas||[]).forEach(t => { if(!soloP||esPendiente(t)) tareasReu.push(t); }));
    });
    });
    collectT(r.temasNuevos, false);
    collectT(r.temasAnt, true);
    (r.tareas||[]).forEach(t => tareasReu.push(t));
    if (!tareasReu.some(t => matchTarea(t, hoy))) return false;
    }
    return true;
    });
    // Si filtro "solo última reunión" está activo, quedar solo con la primera (más reciente, ya ordenadas desc)
    if (S.filtros.soloUltima && reus.length > 0) reus = [reus[0]];
    if (!reus.length && S.filtros.tema !== String(tema.id) && (S.filtros.tipo || q || S.filtros.estadoTarea || S.filtros.responsable || S.filtros.soloUltima)) return;
    totalReus += reus.length;
    const abierto = S.abiertos.temas[tema.id] !== false; // default abierto
    html += `<div class="grupo" data-tid="${tema.id}" draggable="true"
    ondragstart="dragTemaStart(event,${tema.id})"
    ondragover="dragTemaOver(event)"
    ondrop="dragTemaDrop(event,${tema.id})"
    ondragleave="dragTemaLeave(event)">
    <div class="grp-hdr" onclick="toggleTema(${tema.id})">
    <span class="drag-handle" onclick="event.stopPropagation()" style="font-size:15px">⠿</span>
    <span class="grp-arrow ${abierto?'':'closed'}">▾</span>
    <span style="font-size:15px">📁</span>
    <span class="grp-name">${esc(tema.nombre)}</span>
    <span class="grp-cnt">${reus.length}</span>
    <div class="grp-opts" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <button class="grp-opt-btn" title="Renombrar" onclick="renombrarTema(${tema.id})">✏</button>
    <button style="background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif" onclick="nuevaReunion(${tema.id})">+ Reunión</button>
    </div>
    </div>`;
    if (abierto) {
    reus.forEach(r => {
    const activa = S.reunionActiva === r.id; // both are now integers
    // Detectar acta incompleta: falta nombre, objetivo, participantes, o sin temas/tareas
    const todasTareasR = [];
    [...(r.temasAnt||[]),...(r.temasNuevos||[])].forEach(g=>{
    (g.tareas||[]).forEach(t=>todasTareasR.push(t));
    (g.subgrupos||[]).forEach(sg=>{
    (sg.tareas||[]).forEach(t=>todasTareasR.push(t));
    (sg.sub2||[]).forEach(s2=>(s2.tareas||[]).forEach(t=>todasTareasR.push(t)));
    });
    });
    (r.tareas||[]).forEach(t=>todasTareasR.push(t));
    const _getEst = t => t.estado || (t.done ? 'completada' : 'ingresada');
    const esUltimaReu = tema.reuniones[0]?.id === r.id;
    let badge = '';
    if (esUltimaReu && todasTareasR.length) {
    const ing = todasTareasR.filter(t=>_getEst(t)==='ingresada').length;
    const prog = todasTareasR.filter(t=>_getEst(t)==='en_progreso').length;
    const comp = todasTareasR.filter(t=>_getEst(t)==='completada').length;
    const venc = todasTareasR.filter(t=>_getEst(t)!=='completada' && t.p < hoy).length;
    const partes = [];
    if (ing) partes.push(`<span style="color:var(--text2);font-size:11px">Ingresadas: ${ing}</span>`);
    if (prog) partes.push(`<span style="color:var(--blue);font-size:11px">En progreso: ${prog}</span>`);
    if (comp) partes.push(`<span style="color:var(--green);font-size:11px">Completadas: ${comp}</span>`);
    if (venc) partes.push(`<span style="color:var(--border);font-size:11px;margin:0 2px">│</span><span style="color:var(--accent);font-size:11px">Vencidas: ${venc}</span>`);
    if (partes.length) badge = `<span class="badge" style="background:transparent;border:none;gap:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:500">${partes.join('<span style="color:var(--border)">|</span>')}</span>`;
    } else {
    badge = '';
    }
    html += `<div class="subgrupo" data-rid="${r.id}" draggable="true"
    ondragstart="dragReuStart(event,${r.id},${tema.id})"
    ondragover="dragReuOver(event)"
    ondrop="dragReuDrop(event,${r.id},${tema.id})"
    ondragleave="dragReuLeave(event)">
    <div class="sgrp-hdr ${activa?'active':''}" onclick="toggleSelReunion(${r.id},${tema.id},this.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'))" ondblclick="selReunion(${r.id},${tema.id})">
    <span class="drag-handle" onclick="event.stopPropagation()" style="font-size:13px">⠿</span>
    <input type="checkbox" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleSelReunion(${r.id},${tema.id},this)"
    ${activa?'checked':''} style="width:15px;height:15px;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0">
    ${esUltimaReu ? '<span style="font-size:13px">⭐</span>' : '<span style="font-size:13px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none">⭐</span>'}
    <span style="font-size:13px">📂</span>
    <span class="sgrp-num">${esc(r.titulo)}</span>
    <span class="sgrp-title">${esc(r.nombre || '(sin nombre)')}</span>
    <div class="sgrp-meta">
    ${badge}
    <span class="sgrp-fecha">${fmt(r.fecha)}</span>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>`;
    });
    }
    html += `</div>`;
    });
    if (!html) {
    html = `<div class="empty"><div class="empty-ico">🗓️</div><div class="empty-ttl">Sin resultados</div><div class="empty-sub">Prueba ajustando los filtros o creando un nuevo tema</div></div>`;
    }
    lista.innerHTML = html;
    // action bar
    updateActionBar();
    renderSidebar();
    }
    function matchSearch(r, tema, q) {
    if (!q) return true;
    // Campos básicos
    if (r.titulo?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (r.nombre?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (r.objetivo?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (r.comentGeneral?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (tema.nombre?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    // Participantes
    if ((r.participantes||[]).some(p => p.n?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.c?.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return true;
    // Tareas globales
    if ((r.tareas||[]).some(t => t.t?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || t.r?.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return true;
    // Búsqueda recursiva en jerarquía (temasAnt + temasNuevos)
    function buscarEnNivel(obj) {
    try {
    if (!obj) return false;
    if (obj.nombre?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (obj.apuntes) {
    const txt = obj.apuntes.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').toLowerCase();
    if (txt.includes(q)) return true;
    }
    if ((obj.acuerdos||[]).some(ac => (typeof ac==='object'?ac.txt||'':ac||'').toLowerCase().includes(q))) return true;
    if ((obj.tareas||[]).some(t => t.t?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || t.r?.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return true;
    if ((obj.subgrupos||[]).some(sg => buscarEnNivel(sg))) return true;
    if ((obj.sub2||[]).some(s2 => buscarEnNivel(s2))) return true;
    return false;
    } catch(e) { return false; }
    }
    if ((r.temasAnt||[]).some(g => buscarEnNivel(g))) return true;
    if ((r.temasNuevos||[]).some(g => buscarEnNivel(g))) return true;
    return false;
    }
